Perditaj was on what had become one of many regular drifts through the wilderness outside Sentenza. Ostenibly, there was the purpose of observing plants, wildlife, and minerals, for him to become later on for the Order of the Moon's inspection. He didn't like the role that had been found for him much, but he did accept its value. What he hadn't told the order was that the more he changed his shape the easier it became, by now he only had to focus on a specimen for a few moments to become a simplistic copy, and but a minute to become the thing completely. And already most of the knowledge they gained was through his own self-observations while changed. Floatstone technology had made great strides since he had become a large chunk of the stuff for a few hours, then told the researchers all he could about its internal dynamics.

In any case, he now found himself with lots of free time on his drifts, time that could be spent just thinking. Thinking about himself mostly, attempting to expand the self-awareness that he was oddly certain was essential, even as his brethren encouraged him to focus his awareness outwards.

*****

He was being copied. He could sense it, the references being drawn from him to something... else. Something persuading existence that it *was* him. Scanning the plains he spotted a drifting shape in the distance. Appearing like a Spectra, specifically him. An Image. The sort of creature he was theorized to be related to in some way. And it was imitating him. He focused on it; perhaps he could return the favor. Suddenly, he was somewhere else.

Specifically, he was across the field, staring at himself staring at himself. Quickly, he pulled back, out of the Image and into his own body. But the Image was still there, a bundle of sensations like an extra limb. *Go away* he ordered it. Immediately, the Image turned and began to move as swiftly as it could manage in the other direction. The sensations didn't go away though. He could still sense everything the Image sensed, and control it as easily as he controlled himself. He could no more will this away than he could will away his own arms. Well, he could will away his arms, he'd tried taking only part of a form once and it had almost worked. This was more like trying to will away his mind.

So he stopped trying. Instead, he dispatched his new appendage to find more to acquire while he returned to Sentenza. More was better, right?

Granting that it is strange, and unsettling, that anything of any consequence in politics is left to a coin flip.... we should still stop talking about these coin flips.

People are inclined to view any events surrounding politics in an emotionally charged light, and this is a clear example of that. If you suppose there were 6 coin flips and Clinton won all of them, the probability of this happening is about 1.5%. If there were 7 and Clinton won 6 of them, the probability rises to about 5.5%. But far more unlikely things happen all the time, all around the world. A day in which nothing in the world with a 1.5% (or lower) probability of happening happened would be truly unlikely.

Unlikely things happening while everyone is watching is no less likely that them happening when no one is watching.
